title: 1 min supinated dead hang @210
summary: Lift clip of a one-minute supinated-grip dead hang at 210 (bodyweight, presumably lbs). Per the description, he's testing which grip is strongest to decide which to regularly test. Transcript is only background French rap music.

claims.claim: He compares dead hang grips to find his strongest so he knows which one to regularly test himself on.
The supinated dead hang serves as a heavy weighted stretch for the biceps.
